option.value:
services: postgres: image: postgres:15 container_name: sao_postgres environment: POSTGRES_USER: postgres POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres POSTGRES_DB: sao_db volumes: - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data ports: - "5432:5432" healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d sao_db"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5
mongo: image: mongo:6.0 container_name: sao_mongo environment: MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: mongo MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: mongo volumes: - mongo-data:/data/db ports: - "27017:27017" healthcheck: test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "-u", "mongo", "-p", "mongo", "--authenticationDatabase", "admin", "--eval", "db.adminCommand({ ping: 1 })", "--quiet"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5
app: build: . image: sao-telegram-bot:local container_name: sao_app depends_on: - postgres - mongo environment: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/sao_db SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: postgres SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: postgres SPRING_DATA_MONGODB_URI: mongodb://mongo:mongo@mongo:27017/sao_bot_mongo?authSource=admin BOT_TOKEN: ${BOT_TOKEN} BOT_NAME: ${BOT_NAME:-sao_telegram_bot} SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE: ${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:-dev} SERVER_PORT: ${SERVER_PORT:-8080} MANAGEMENT_PORT: ${MANAGEMENT_PORT:-8080} ports: - "8080:8080" restart: on-failure # don't mount source by default; if you want hot-reload during development uncomment below and use bootRun # volumes: # - ./:/app # command: ["./gradlew", "bootRun"]
volumes: postgres-data: mongo-data:
